scope: Current plain-M5 Y-seam geometry: closed printed parts, straight assembly motions and funnel-frame bearing/capture. Nominal geometry is not physical fit, support-removal acceptance, retained clamp force, load capacity, drop acceptance or lifetime.

native_geometry.scope: Source-bound containment-envelope geometry; final quadrants are established by subtractive_head_access_update. The frame and front quadrants retain these dimensions. No physical fit, support-removal acceptance, retained clamp force, load, drop or lifetime result.
native_geometry.evidence_stage: Native geometry before the final inboard head-access openings. The stated source hashes identify those measured inputs. The final native subset proof below carries the zero-overlap results forward; the funnel frame and front quadrants are unchanged.

printed_mesh_motion.method: Manifold3D closed STL solids, dense sampled straight Y translations. This checks assembly motion of printed parts at stated nominal dimensions; actual fit, removal of printed supports, load capacity and lifetime are unmeasured. Installed packed components are reviewed separately.

motions.motion: Slide back-top onto joined bottoms and front-top
Close back-top around seated funnel frame

printed_mesh_motion.evidence_stage: The173 listed poses were measured on these explicitly hashed pre-head-access meshes. Final head access removes stock only, as proved below; these pose readings are retained with their original hashes and are not presented as resampled final meshes.

assembly_sequence: Install the brass inserts while their individual printed parts are accessible.
Populate front-top with its fixed valve rows and moving tee links, then slide it aft onto front-bottom.
Seat the funnel frame in front-top before the Y-seam closing motion.
Populate back-top on the bench, then slide it forward onto an empty back-bottom.
Move the complete back column forward over the tethered cold core into the front column at the Y telescope; cabinet-spanning plumbing follows the mechanical close.
With grip covers removed, insert the lower screw pair upward through the handholds; install the upper pair through the roof. Each head uses one flat washer.
Refit the grip covers after the lower screws are seated.

access.lower_screw_entry: upward through handhold ceiling with removable grip cover removed

frame_support: The front receiver pair carries the frame; the rear frame body clears the upper screw blocks. Nominal capture against six 2 mm translations does not establish a load rating or resistance to tilting under load.
assembly_sequence_basis: hardware/assembly/enclosure-mechanical.md §6. The additional back-top-only sweeps in this report establish printed-shell geometric compatibility and do not replace the populated-machine assembly sequence.

subtractive_head_access_update.scope: Final inboard-open head access: native subtraction from the previously reviewed quadrants, complete washer floors and refreshed final-mesh funnel capture. The original173 sampled motions remain explicitly bound to their earlier mesh hashes. The nominal updated shell stock is a subset, so it cannot add a shell or packed-body interference.

head_access_review.scope: One-time manual native head-seat and upper exterior access-mouth review; no strength, deposited print, load or lifetime qualification. No build-path integration.

rows.named_scope: Only upper head-access exterior mouth within existing roof taper; inboard thin cup wall is removed by U opening. Floor and load-bearing root retain their separate complete sections.

packing_motion_review.scope: Continuous conservative swept bounding-stock proof for only the new Y-seam corner blocks during the established back-column ride over the core. Complete shell/packed-unit motions and tube disconnection/service motions are outside this targeted proof.
packing_motion_review.method: A moving block is conservatively enclosed by its bounding prism extended along the complete positive-Y withdrawal/inverse insertion interval. A separating or tangent bounding plane proves no volumetric interference; overlapping boxes receive native prism/body intersections. Screw passages and head pockets only remove material from this checked stock.
packing_motion_review.pack_reference: Retained packed bodies and fixed placements from enclosure-assembly.step; printed enclosure shell stock is constructed from the current generator, not taken from this snapshot.

installed_geometry_conditions.operation: Cut tube end flush with foam flank, as already required by cold-core assembly instructions. The exported construction route extends 2 mm outside that plane.

excluded_install_later: all routed tubes and turn/step bodies
pump cartridge and its pump hardware
packing_motion_review.assembly_sequence_basis: hardware/assembly/enclosure-mechanical.md §6 and hardware/assembly/internal-plumbing.md: back-top populates and slides onto empty back-bottom; complete back column then rides over core; cabinet-spanning tubes follow closure. MOUNTS/RIDES resolve fixed/co-moving hardware.

installed_prv_vent_export.scope: Installed PRV tube end in the local internal-route export and retained appliance frame. All seven other route viewer entries were retained exactly during the scoped refresh; native export serialization retains the measured geometric fingerprints.
installed_prv_vent_export.world_shape_basis: Trimmed retained appliance instance; its current placement and the other appliance route instances are preserved.
installed_prv_vent_export.verification_method_note: Coincident swept tube STEP solids can return their full volumes for both directions of a native subtraction. Native face/edge/vertex counts, locations, lengths, areas, bounds and volumes are compared explicitly here, alongside exact retained viewer entries.

vent_clearance_review.interpretation: The exported route retains the construction tail that finishes its bend. The installed tube is already specified cut flush to the foam flank. Checking that installed shape removes the moving-hub interference without changing the tube route or shell stock.

retained_front_exports_consistency.scope: Additional inboard head-access cutter relative to the prior circular recess intersected against retained front quadrant native exports. Zero intersection establishes that applying the current shared bore helper removes no further front-quadrant stock.
